question_text:
A box plot has been drawn to show the heights of some petunia seedlings, in centimetres.
State the:

mark_breakdown.desc: Correct minimum value read from plot

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The minimum value is the position of the leftmost tip of the whisker.
step_by_step: Read the value at the end of the lower whisker: 4 cm.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Reading from the edge of the box rather than the whisker.

mark_breakdown.desc: Correct maximum value read from plot

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The maximum value is the position of the rightmost tip of the whisker.
step_by_step: Read the value at the end of the upper whisker: 22 cm.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The median is indicated by the vertical line inside the box.
step_by_step: Find the line inside the box and read the corresponding axis value: 17 cm.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Assuming the median is always in the exact geometric center of the box.

mark_breakdown.desc: Correct upper quartile read from plot

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The upper quartile ($Q_3$) is the right edge of the box.
step_by_step: Read the value at the right edge of the box: 19 cm.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Confusing the upper quartile with the maximum.

mark_breakdown.desc: Correct lower quartile read from plot

ai_explanation.concept_rule: The lower quartile ($Q_1$) is the left edge of the box.
step_by_step: Read the value at the left edge of the box: 11 cm.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Confusing the lower quartile with the minimum.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Range is calculated as the maximum value minus the minimum value.
step_by_step: Subtract the minimum (4) from the maximum (22): $22 - 4 = 18\text{ cm}$.
ai_explanation.common_pitfalls: Forgetting the units or subtracting quartiles.

ai_explanation.concept_rule: Interquartile range is the width of the box: $Q_3 - Q_1$.
step_by_step: Subtract the lower quartile (11) from the upper quartile (19): $19 - 11 = 8\text{ cm}$.
